test_title: PYST 35: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 2 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined words in the given sentence.**

In the olden days, most of the groundwater was __safe to drink__ because there was no contamination from industries or sewage.
solution:
Here the correct answer is **Potable.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct option that can substitute the underlined words in the given sentence is **option 4) potable.**
 
• The word** "potable" **means** safe to drink.**
 
 
• Example: The water in this area is not **potable**, so we need to boil it before drinking.
 
 
 
• **Option 1) vulnerable **means susceptible to harm, damage, or attack, and is not an appropriate substitute for the underlined words in the given sentence.
 
 
• Example: The elderly are more **vulnerable **to the flu than younger people.
 
 
 
• **Option 2) edible** means fit to be eaten, and is not an appropriate substitute for the underlined words in the given sentence.
 
 
• Example: The berries in the forest are **edible**, but be careful not to pick the poisonous ones.
 
 
 
• **Option 3) useful **means able to be used for a practical purpose, and is not an appropriate substitute for the underlined words in the given sentence.
 
 
• Example: The new smartphone app is very **useful **for managing my finances.
 
 
 
• In conclusion, the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined words in the given sentence is** option 4) potable**, which means **safe to drink.**
